title: DvPSettlement
description: Platform-agnostic DvP settlement record schema for OTAS token primitives

assetToken.description: Address or identifier of the token being sold

assetAmount.description: Amount of asset tokens to be transferred to buyer

paymentToken.description: Address or identifier of the token used for payment

paymentAmount.description: Amount of payment tokens to be transferred to seller

buyer.description: Address or identity receiving asset tokens on finalise

seller.description: Address or identity receiving payment tokens on finalise

expiry.description: Block number or timestamp after which abort is callable

holdId.description: Reference to the Hold record locking seller asset tokens

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement
